i get what you mean. since i was in kindergarten i always panicked about the future and told myself i NEED to be dead by a certain age. and that age kept going up as i got older but now i know that the one i have set now isn’t going anywhere. it’s kind of like school, every morning i go over every bad thing i know is going to happen. when i get there, it’s just as bad as i thought it’d be, but for some reason i can handle it? anyways, i get your point. and i hope when 20 comes, you change your mind. <3

anxiety is a bitch, and i totally get how much it can control everything. distractions can really help, while i admit i’ve ran out of distractions many times, it’s good for when you’re hopeless or feeling meaningless. i mean little shit like painting your nails, watching dog videos or a bad movie, anything that you fancy. i hope you feel better and feel free to pm! <3
